manifest.name: Sewers Cards Addition
manifest.description: A card expansion themed around sewers.

sewers:sealed.name: Sealed
sewers:sealed.description: While present, this equipment's effects are inactive, it cannot be triggered, and its equipped-turn count does not increase; Equipment Armor remains active. At the start of its owner's turn, skip its effects for that start, then remove 1 stack.

sewers:lotus.name: Lotus
sewers:lotus.description: A flower that grows in poisonous places.

sewers:light_bulb.name: Light Bulb
sewers:light_bulb.effect_text: Until the start of your next turn, every card that selects a player target is forced to target this card's user. Cards that do not select a target are unaffected. This effect does not apply while this card's user is not selectable.

sewers:talisman_of_evasion.name: Talisman of Evasion
sewers:talisman_of_evasion.effect_text: at the start of the target's turn, apply 1 stack of dodge to the target.

sewers:broccoli.name: Broccoli
sewers:broccoli.effect_text: Deal 10[[icon:D]] to the target, then clear this card's Power; if this card is countered, deal an additional 3[[icon:D]]×2 to the target. The additional damage is not increased by Power

sewers:clay.name: Clay
sewers:clay.effect_text: Deal 5[[icon:D]]to the target; when this card is in hand, every time you receive ≥8 actual damage, the power of this card will be +3, and you can gain up to 18 stacks of power from this.

sewers:vampire_fang.name: Vampire Fang
sewers:vampire_fang.effect_text: Each time the target is selected as a target by an enemy card, recover 3[[icon:H]]
sewers:vampire_fang.description: I'm no longer a human being!

sewers:blood_rose.name: Blood Rose
sewers:blood_rose.effect_text: Deal 3[[icon:D]]to the target; when hit, the target will gain 3 stacks of Blind at the start of the next turn; the target will be restored (actual damage × 5)[[icon:H]]

sewers:bubonic_plague.name: Bubonic Plague
sewers:bubonic_plague.effect_text: Apply 6 stacks of poison to the target

sewers:poo.name: Poo
sewers:poo.effect_text: Apply 1 level of attack ban to the target
sewers:poo.description: No one would want to go near it.

sewers:iodine.name: Iodine
sewers:iodine.effect_text: At the start of the equipment owner's turn, restore 5[[icon:H]] to every selectable target; after being equipped for 1 turn, you may spend 3[[icon:E]] to trigger: destroy this equipment, choose 1 target, deal 12[[icon:D]] to them, and apply 12[[icon:P]]

sewers:cheese.name: Cheese
sewers:cheese.effect_text: When an enemy counters a card played by the equipment holder, destroy this equipment; on that enemy's next turn, force them to play Thorn cards from left to right against the equipment holder, ending the turn when none can be played

sewers:perfume.name: Perfume
sewers:perfume.effect_text: Apply 1 stack of Attack Blocked to the target
sewers:perfume.description: Fragrant or foul—that is the question.

sewers:acid_bomb.name: Acid Bomb
sewers:acid_bomb.effect_text: Deal 8[[icon:D]] to the target; when damage is dealt, apply 5[[icon:P]] to the target

sewers:dung.name: Dung
sewers:dung.effect_text: Apply 1[[icon:F]] to the attacker  Response: Targeted by a Thorn card

sewers:chitin.name: Chitin
sewers:chitin.effect_text: At the start of the target's turn, if they have no Nazar, apply 1 Nazar to them

sewers:whiskers.name: Whiskers
sewers:whiskers.effect_text: Give every equipment owned by the target 1 stack of Sealed

sewers:neem.name: Neem
sewers:neem.effect_text: While present, after a player other than the target loses [[icon:H]] to Poison, restore [[icon:H]] to the target equal to 50% of the actual loss, rounded down
sewers:neem.description: Call me the master of poison.

sewers:basil.name: Basil
sewers:basil.effect_text: At the start of the equipment owner's turn, restore 3[[icon:H]] to the target; if the target has no more than 40% of their maximum [[icon:H]] before this resolves, restore 5[[icon:H]] more

sewers:neurotoxin.name: Neurotoxin
sewers:neurotoxin.effect_text: Apply 7[[icon:P]] to the target; afterward, if they have at least 22[[icon:P]], apply 1 Stun, otherwise apply 1 Weakness

sewers:toilet_paper.name: Toilet Paper
sewers:toilet_paper.effect_text: Deal 8[[icon:D]] to the target; while this card is in your hand, each time you take actual physical damage, this card gains 1 Power (up to 24 Power from this effect)
sewers:toilet_paper.description: Everyone has it. The question is whether you know how to use it.

sewers:quartz.name: Quartz
sewers:quartz.effect_text: Give every card currently in your hand Temporary Swift:1
